Gm Advisory Group Increases Holding in Apple (AAPL); Btg Pactual Global Asset Management LTD Has Cut Its Anheuser Busch Inbev Sa/Nv (BUD) Holding by $7.99 Million 
April 20, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson 
Gm Advisory Group Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.99% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gm Advisory Group Inc bought 3,306 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 36,383 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.16 million, up from 33,077 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gm Advisory Group Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $876.79B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.83% or $5.04 during the last trading session, reaching $172.8. About 31.52M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
